entity.summary: Centralized cryptocurrency exchange in the Global Commercial Business ecosystem offering spot, P2P, perpetual-futures, leveraged-ETF, fiat/crypto deposit, and multi-device trading services.
entity.notes: Fresh review found current first-party documentation and a live trading surface. The official roadmap states an exchange launch in Q1 2024, but no exact calendar date was confirmed, so HEI leaves launch_date null rather than introducing false precision. Current first-party materials describe global access but do not establish a durable legal jurisdiction for registry purposes.

evidence.title: GCB Exchange cryptocurrency-exchange introduction
evidence.notes: First-party documentation identifies GCB Exchange as a cryptocurrency trading platform and describes P2P trading, perpetual futures, leveraged ETFs, KYC/2FA, web/mobile clients, and a REST API.

evidence.title: GCB ecosystem roadmap
evidence.notes: First-party roadmap places Exchange Launch in Q1 2024 and Exchange Core expansion in Q2 2024. Because it supplies only quarter-level timing, HEI does not convert it to an exact launch_date.

evidence.title: GCB Exchange live trading surface
evidence.notes: First-party exchange surface is live and exposes market, trade, futures, deposit, OTC, login, signup, and application-download entry points, supporting active status.
